_compliance: SOC 2 and ISO 27001 as each provider states on its own site; providers left out make no claim we could find.

groundbox.note: Says it has no SOC 2 report.

luxor.note: Its parent company, Luxor Technology, has a SOC 2 Type II report.

runners.notes: Baseline. 4 vCPU / 16 GB on public repos, where it's free; priced at GitHub's 4-core larger runner rate, the paid equivalent.

runners.name: Luxor

runners.name: Groundbox
runners.label: groundbox-4vcpu
runners.notes: groundbox.dev. Ubuntu 24.04, one Firecracker microVM per job. $0.0015 per vCPU-minute.

runners.name: Namespace
runners.label: nscloud-ubuntu-24.04-amd64-4x8
runners.notes: 4x8 is Namespace's standard 4 vCPU shape: 4 compute units at $0.001 each. Usage above a plan's included unit minutes is billed at the $0.006 overage rate.

runners.name: Celesto
runners.label: celesto-large
runners.notes: Large is Celesto's 4 vCPU / 16 GB size on Ubuntu 24.04. Billed per second of runtime, which also includes runner preparation and cleanup.

runners.name: Jog
runners.label: jog-4vcpu
runners.notes: usejog.com. Ubuntu 24.04, billed per second. jog-max is a faster tier at twice the price.

runners.name: RunJob
runners.label: runjob-ubuntu-24.04
runners.notes: runjob.eu (Puzl Cloud). No fixed sizes: free-plan jobs get up to 12 vCPU and 32 GB on shared cores. Billed per second for load, not time: EUR 0.00002 per vCPU-second used plus EUR 0.000001 per GB-second, so there's no per-minute price.

runners.name: boat
runners.label: boat
runners.pricing_caveat: Needs a plan from $20 a month, which comes back as VM time. Job starts above the plan's included number cost $0.03-0.07 each.
runners.notes: boat.dev. Ubuntu 24.04, one fresh VM per job, billed per second. Needs a plan from $20/month; the plan amount comes back as VM time. Starts above the plan's included count cost $0.03-0.07 each.

runners.name: Homemade
runners.label: homemade-small
runners.pricing_caveat: Pro is $20 a month and includes $20 of running time. Hobby is free with lower limits.
runners.notes: homemade.dev. Ubuntu 24.04, 4 vCPU, 8 GB, one fresh microVM per job, billed per second. Pro is $20 a month and includes $20 of running time.

runners.name: Instabox
runners.label: instabox-medium
runners.pricing_caveat: Pro is $20 a month and includes $20 of usage. The free plan runs one instabox-medium machine at a time.
runners.notes: instabox.sh. Ubuntu 24.04, 4 vCPU, 8 GiB, a fresh machine per job. $0.004 per vCPU-hour plus $0.00225 per GiB-hour, billed per second.
